text: Being able to speak Hebrew isn't a factor at the interview - so your partner shouldn't stress you about that :) (For what it's worth, I am almost fluent but still choose to do my interview in English, as I don't want any points of confusion to cause problems). But yes, it is still good to learn Hebrew anyway - I'd strongly recommend ulpans - the structured classes and professional teachers make a massive difference. Even though they can be expensive, I think they are worth every shekel
